To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the inverter side inductance is the most important component in an LCL filter design, and the inductor current ripple is an important parameter to consider in LCL filter design.
a 3-level NPC inverter with LCL filter can achieve high power factor and small size, with a detailed analysis of L1 ripple and loss.
the inductor current ripple is analyzed based on SVM, and L1, L2 and C filter are designed with good filtering performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the LCL filter design for 3-level grid interfacing converters.
the inductor current ripple and loss analysis, and the design of LCL filter for 3-level neutral-point-clamped grid interface converter.
the design of LCL filter for a 200 kVA three level NPC converter.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LCL filter design and the inductor ripple analysis are very useful for the 3-level NPC inverter filter design.
the LCL filter design for 3-level grid interface converter is presented with the consideration of the ripple current and the size tradeoff.
the LCL filter design is a compromise between the size, cost, attenuation and loss.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a good filter design can be achieved with the consideration of ripple current, attenuation, size and loss.
we have designed the LCL filter for 3-level grid interface converter with good performance and small size.
the design of LCL harmonic filter for NPC converter is given with detailed analysis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the LCL filter design can be done in an easy way with the inductor ripple analysis, which helps to understand the ripple current behavior in LCL filter.
the inductor current ripple is the key parameter for LCL filter design and it can be calculated accurately based on SVM.
a detailed current ripple equation for inverter side L1 is presented and the design of inductor L1 and capacitor is based on the equation and the size loss tradeoff.
